== frame after_backslash cursor=1,2
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame joined cursor=4,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
|  two
|one two
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame after_and cursor=5,2
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
|  two
|one two
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true &&
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame and_done cursor=8,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
|  two
|one two
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true &&
|  echo and-done
|and-done
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame or_done cursor=12,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
|  two
|one two
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ true &&
|  echo and-done
|and-done
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ false ||
|  echo or-done
|or-done
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@4 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@8 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@12 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~

== frame quote_done cursor=16,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo one \
|  two
|one two

|  echo and-done
